task: A colleague comments on the cold morning. Agree and add a detail.
say: Bit chilly this morning, eh?
zh: 同事说今天早上很冷。表示同意，再加一个细节。对方说：“今天早上有点冷啊？”
example: Yeah, freezing! I had to scrape the ice off my windscreen.

task: You are in Wellington on a windy day. Someone comments on it. Agree and add a detail.
say: Typical Wellington, eh? Blowing a gale out there.
zh: 你在惠灵顿，风很大，有人聊起天气。表示同意，再加一个细节。对方说：“典型的惠灵顿天气，外面狂风大作。”
example: Tell me about it. I nearly lost my umbrella on the way in. It's completely inside out.

task: A friend asks if you want coffee. Accept and suggest a time.
say: Keen for a coffee later?
zh: 朋友问你要不要一起喝咖啡。接受，再提议一个时间。对方说：“待会儿想去喝杯咖啡吗？”
example: Yeah, keen! Does half ten suit you? I'll be ready for a break by then.

task: A colleague asks about the rugby last night. You missed it. Answer and ask back.
say: Did you watch the game last night?
zh: 同事问你昨晚有没有看橄榄球比赛，你错过了。回答，再反问。对方说：“昨晚的比赛你看了吗？”
example: No, I missed it! Who won? Was it a good one?

task: A colleague asks about your plans for the long weekend. Answer and ask back.
say: Got any plans for the long weekend?
zh: 同事问你长周末有什么安排。回答，再反问。对方说：“长周末有什么安排吗？”
example: Nothing big, just a bit of gardening and maybe a beach walk. How about you?

task: You held the door for someone. They thank you in Kiwi slang. Reply in a friendly way.
say: Chur, bro.
zh: 你帮别人扶了门，对方用新西兰俚语道谢。友好地回应。对方说：“谢了，兄弟。”
example: No worries at all, mate. Sweet as. Have a good rest of your day.

task: The weather keeps changing today. Someone comments. Agree and add a detail.
say: Four seasons in one day today, eh?
zh: 今天天气变来变去，有人聊起来。表示同意，再加一个细节。对方说：“今天一天四季啊？”
example: Honestly! It was sunny when I left home, and now look at it. Glad I grabbed a jacket.

task: A colleague asks if you go hiking. Answer and add a detail.
say: Have you done much tramping since you got here?
zh: 同事问你来了以后有没有去徒步。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“你来了以后经常去徒步吗？”
example: A little bit. I did the Tongariro Crossing last summer. My legs hated me for days.

task: Someone asks how you like living in NZ. Answer with a detail.
say: So how are you finding New Zealand?
zh: 有人问你觉得在新西兰生活怎么样。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“你觉得新西兰怎么样？”
example: I love it. People are really friendly and the beaches are amazing. The weather still surprises me, though.

task: Someone asks where you are from. Answer, add a detail and ask back.
say: Where are you from originally?
zh: 有人问你是哪里人。回答，加个细节，再反问。对方说：“你老家是哪里的？”
example: I'm from {hometown}. The food there is amazing, and I miss it heaps. Are you from around here?

task: It's a very hot summer day. A colleague jokes about it. Answer and add a detail.
say: Hot enough for you?
zh: 这是个炎热的夏天，同事拿天气开玩笑。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“够热了吧？”
example: Ha, almost too hot! I had the fan going all night. Not complaining, though.

task: A colleague asks about your Christmas plans. Answer, add a detail and ask back.
say: What are you up to for Christmas?
zh: 同事问你圣诞节有什么安排。回答，加个细节，再反问。对方说：“圣诞节打算干嘛？”
example: We're having a barbecue with friends, then heading to the beach. What about you, staying in town?

task: A friend is going to the beach. Show interest and ask a follow-up question.
say: We're heading out to Piha on Saturday.
zh: 朋友要去海滩。表示兴趣，再追问一个问题。对方说：“我们周六去 Piha 海滩。”
example: Oh, nice! Are you going for a swim or just a walk? I hear the surf can get pretty wild out there.

task: A colleague asks if you follow rugby now. Answer, add a detail and ask back.
say: So, are you an All Blacks fan yet?
zh: 同事问你现在是不是全黑队的球迷了。回答，加个细节，再反问。对方说：“你现在成全黑队球迷了吗？”
example: Getting there! I still don't get all the rules, but the haka gives me goosebumps every time. Do you go to the games?

task: A colleague is going to their holiday house. Show interest with a follow-up question.
say: We're heading up to the bach this weekend.
zh: 同事这周末要去度假小屋。表示兴趣，再追问一个问题。对方说：“我们这周末去海边小屋。”
example: Oh, nice! Where's the bach? Is it right on the water?

task: A colleague complains about the traffic. Show sympathy and share your own experience.
say: Traffic was an absolute nightmare this morning.
zh: 同事抱怨早上堵车。表示同情，再分享你自己的经历。对方说：“今天早上堵车简直是噩梦。”
example: Same! It took me fifty minutes to get across the bridge. I'm seriously thinking about taking the bus.

task: A friend asks if you have watched cricket. Answer and show interest with a question.
say: Have you been to a cricket match yet?
zh: 朋友问你有没有去看过板球比赛。回答，再问一个问题表示兴趣。对方说：“你去看过板球比赛了吗？”
example: Not yet! I still don't really get the rules. Is a test match really five days long?

task: Someone in the supermarket queue talks about prices. Agree lightly with a personal comment.
say: Can you believe the price of butter at the moment?
zh: 超市排队时有人聊起物价。轻松地同意，再说说自己的情况。对方说：“现在黄油的价格你敢信吗？”
example: I know, it's crazy! I nearly put it back on the shelf last week. Might have to start baking less.

task: A colleague asks about camping. Answer with a detail and ask back.
say: Are you going camping at all this summer?
zh: 同事问你今年夏天去不去露营。回答并加一个细节，再反问。对方说：“今年夏天你去露营吗？”
example: We're hoping to. We've booked a spot in the Coromandel for a few nights. Do you camp much?

task: A colleague who lives across town asks about the rain. Answer with a detail.
say: Did you get much rain over your way?
zh: 住在城另一头的同事问你那边雨大不大。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“你那边雨下得大吗？”
example: Heaps! Our backyard's basically a swimming pool. Our street turned into a river for a bit.

task: A Kiwi asks if you understand their accent. Answer with humour and a small example.
say: So can you understand us Kiwis yet?
zh: 一个新西兰人问你能不能听懂他们的口音。幽默地回答，再举一个小例子。对方说：“你现在能听懂我们新西兰人说话了吗？”
example: Mostly! The first time someone asked me to grab the chilly bin, I had no idea what they meant. I just stood there.

task: A colleague talks about Christmas in summer. Agree and share a short contrast.
say: Christmas at the beach must feel weird for you.
zh: 同事聊起夏天过圣诞。表示同意，再讲讲两边的不同。对方说：“在海滩过圣诞，你肯定觉得很奇怪吧。”
example: It still feels strange! Back home it was cold and dark in winter. Here I'm having a barbecue in jandals.

task: A friend says they might move to Australia. Show interest and ask a follow-up question.
say: We're thinking of moving to the Gold Coast. Half our friends have gone already.
zh: 朋友说他们可能要搬去澳大利亚。表示兴趣，再追问一个问题。对方说：“我们在考虑搬去黄金海岸，一半的朋友已经去了。”
example: Really? I'd miss you guys! What's pulling you over there, the weather or the work?

task: A neighbour talks about rent going up. Answer lightly with a personal detail.
say: Rent's gone up again, hasn't it?
zh: 邻居聊起房租又涨了。轻松地回答，说说自己的情况。对方说：“房租又涨了，是吧？”
example: Yeah, ours went up fifty bucks a week. We're cooking at home a lot more now, which is probably no bad thing.

task: A colleague asks about the cricket team. You don't know much. Answer honestly and turn it back.
say: Reckon the Black Caps have a chance this summer?
zh: 同事问你对板球队的看法，你不太懂。诚实回答，再把问题抛回去。对方说：“你觉得黑帽队今年夏天有戏吗？”
example: Honestly, no idea, I'm still learning the game! They looked good last week, though. What do you reckon?

task: A colleague asks about a public holiday. Answer and ask back with interest.
say: Matariki weekend's coming up. Doing anything for it?
zh: 同事问你公共假期的安排。回答，再感兴趣地反问。对方说：“马塔里基周末快到了，有什么安排吗？”
example: Nothing big. Maybe head up a hill early to see the stars. Do you usually do anything special for it?

task: A friend asks what you miss about home. Answer with a detail.
say: What do you miss most about home?
zh: 朋友问你最想念家乡的什么。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“你最想念家乡的什么？”
example: Honestly, the food. Proper street food at midnight. I've found a couple of good spots on Dominion Road, though.

task: Someone complains about the buses. Disagree politely.
say: The buses here are a joke, eh?
zh: 有人抱怨公交。礼貌地表示不同意。对方说：“这里的公交简直是个笑话，是吧？”
example: They're not perfect, but mine's actually been pretty good lately. Maybe I've just been lucky!

task: A friend invites you on a long hike. Accept with humour and ask a question.
say: Keen for a tramp on Saturday? It's about five hours.
zh: 朋友邀请你去长途徒步。幽默地接受，再问一个问题。对方说：“周六一起去徒步吗？大概五个小时。”
example: Keen, but be honest, how steep is it? I need to know how many snacks to pack.

task: A colleague says you must try a Kiwi pie. Tell a short story about your first one.
say: You've gotta try a mince and cheese pie, mate.
zh: 同事说你一定要尝尝新西兰肉派。讲一个你第一次吃的小故事。对方说：“你一定得试试肉末芝士派。”
example: Already have! I got one at a petrol station on a road trip. Burnt my mouth on the first bite, but it was worth it.

task: A friend talks about crazy weather. React with surprise and tell a short story.
say: Did you see that hail this afternoon? In December!
zh: 朋友聊起奇怪的天气。表示惊讶，再讲个小故事。对方说：“你看到今天下午的冰雹了吗？十二月啊！”
example: Yeah! I was walking to the car and got pelted. Honestly, this country's weather has a sense of humour.

task: Someone asks about your favourite place in NZ. Tell a short story.
say: Where's the best place you've been in New Zealand so far?
zh: 有人问你在新西兰最喜欢的地方。讲一个小故事。对方说：“到目前为止，你在新西兰去过最棒的地方是哪里？”
example: Probably Milford Sound. It rained the whole time, but there were waterfalls everywhere. The guide said we were lucky.

task: A friend jokes about who you support in rugby. Joke back.
say: So who do you support in the rugby? You can't say Australia!
zh: 朋友开玩笑问你支持哪个橄榄球队。用玩笑回应。对方说：“你支持哪支橄榄球队？不许说澳大利亚！”
example: Ha, don't worry, I'm a proper All Blacks fan now. Though I still have to ask my mates what a ruck is.

task: A neighbour talks about house prices. Keep it light, agree a little and add a positive.
say: House prices, eh? My kids will never be able to buy.
zh: 邻居聊起房价。保持轻松，稍微表示同意，再说点积极的。对方说：“房价啊，我的孩子们永远买不起房。”
example: Yeah, it's tough out there. We're happy renting for now. At least someone else fixes the leaky tap!

task: A colleague asks about Kiwi words. Answer with humour.
say: What's the weirdest Kiwi word you've learned?
zh: 同事问你学过的新西兰词。幽默地回答。对方说：“你学过最奇怪的新西兰词是什么？”
example: Probably togs. The first time I heard it, I thought someone had lost their dog. Still not sure about munted, either.

task: A colleague asks about the long weekend. Tell a short story about your trip.
say: Did you get away for Labour Weekend?
zh: 同事问你劳动节长周末有没有出去玩。讲一个关于这次旅行的小故事。对方说：“劳动节长周末你出去玩了吗？”
example: We went to Rotorua. The mud pools were amazing, but I couldn't get used to the smell. Very relaxing, though.

task: A friend asks about your future in NZ. Answer thoughtfully but lightly.
say: So do you reckon you'll stay in New Zealand for good?
zh: 朋友问你将来是否会一直留在新西兰。认真但轻松地回答。对方说：“你觉得你会一直留在新西兰吗？”
example: I reckon so. Every time I go back to visit, I miss the space here after about a week. And I feel like a proper Kiwi now.

task: Someone links your home country to their own story. Show interest and ask a follow-up question.
say: Oh, you're from China? My brother taught English in Shanghai for a year!
zh: 有人把你的家乡和他自己的故事联系起来。表示兴趣，再追问一个问题。对方说：“哦，你是中国人？我哥在上海教过一年英语！”
example: Oh, really? Did he enjoy it? Shanghai's pretty full on. I'd love to hear what he thought of the food.

task: A friend teases you for wearing jandals in winter. Joke back.
say: Mate, you've gone full Kiwi. Jandals in winter!
zh: 朋友取笑你冬天还穿人字拖。用玩笑回应。对方说：“老兄，你完全变成新西兰人了，冬天穿人字拖！”
example: Ha, I know! Next step is going barefoot to the supermarket. Give me another year.

task: The All Blacks lost a big final. A colleague is upset. Show sympathy with a bit of humour.
say: Did you watch the final? I'm still not over it.
zh: 全黑队输了一场重要的决赛，同事很难过。带点幽默地表示同情。对方说：“你看决赛了吗？我到现在还没缓过来。”
example: Oh, don't. I watched it at a mate's place and the whole room went dead quiet. We'll get them next time.
